title: BEML Limited (NSE: BEML) — Institutional Investment Monograph
holding_rationale: BEML is not held in the Zerodha IN portfolio (0 shares in the 2026-11-20 positions ledger); no trim or exit execution is required, and new capital is rejected on valuation (104.4x TTM P/E vs. ₹1,850 base-case fair value) and cash-flow (191 debtor days, negative FY25–FY26 FCF) grounds.

holding_alerts.trigger: Price corrects below ₹1,450 OR audited FCF turns sustainably positive with >=12% OPM for 2 consecutive quarters
holding_alerts.instruction: Do not initiate at ₹2,052.40; re-underwrite only if valuation resets below ₹1,450 or cash conversion inflects.

redeployment_plan.capital_source: Next marginal ₹1,00,000 of new Indian equity capital (BEML not held; 0 shares freed)

destinations.rationale: BEML fails valuation and cash-flow gates at 104.4x TTM P/E; preserving cash avoids paying peak multiples for negative-FCF PSU execution.
destinations.entry_condition: Deploy only into cleared shortlist dip setups or re-underwritten industrial compounders.

destinations.rationale: Already inside its ₹1,156.09–₹1,210.50 dip zone at ₹1,200.00 with 2.62:1 asymmetry to ₹1,420.00 base target.
destinations.entry_condition: Buy within ₹1,156.09–₹1,210.50 with ₹1,102.78 stop if seeking immediate pharma deployment.

destinations.recommendation: Queue Action Construction Equipment for Standalone Dossier
destinations.rationale: Superior capital efficiency (25.2% ROE, 31.6% ROCE, 15.0% OPM) at 27.26x P/E in Stage 2 vs. BEML at 104.4x P/E.
destinations.entry_condition: Requires full standalone blind-first underwriting before capital allocation.

primer: BEML Limited (NSE: BEML) is a 62-year-old Defence PSU holding over 45% domestic metro car share and a record ₹21,388 crore order book. Despite a constructive Stage 2 chart at ₹2,052.40, new capital is REJECTED on Valuation and Cash Flow grounds. The stock trades at 104.39x trailing earnings against 4.85% ROE, 191 debtor days, and negative free cash flow in FY25 and FY26. Our ₹1,850 base-case fair value sits below the current price, so marginal capital stays in cash.
